hero.title: About {name} AI
hero.body: A national AI platform that connects cooperative training to verifiable skills and real employment — built for the Ministry of Cooperation and National Council for Cooperative Training (NCCT).

mission.label: Our Mission
mission.title: Close the loop between training and livelihood
mission.body: India's cooperative sector trains thousands every year, yet outcomes remain invisible — fragmented across institutions with no digital thread connecting a trainee's learning journey to employment. CoopSetu AI changes that.
mission.passportBody: We give every trainee a living, AI-powered {passport} that employers can trust, every institution a real-time dashboard, and NCCT a national analytics view of skill supply and demand.

problem.label: Problem Statement · SIH 2026 PS 26087
problem.title: What we're solving
problem.intro: The Smart India Hackathon 2026 Problem Statement 26087, issued by the Ministry of Cooperation, identifies critical gaps in the cooperative training ecosystem:

points.0: No unified digital record of cooperative training outcomes
points.2: Gap between skills trained and skills demanded by employers
points.3: Employers cannot verify claimed cooperative competencies
points.4: NCCT has no real-time visibility into national training throughput

problem.closing: CoopSetu AI directly addresses every one of these gaps with a single integrated platform.

notes.title: Lesson Study Guide & Notes
notes.storedLocally: Stored locally on your device for offline reading anytime.
notes.principle: In democratic cooperative enterprises, every member has one vote regardless of the number of shares held. Transparent bookkeeping, routine audits, and accurate inventory accounting ensure that member welfare remains protected.

checklist.0: Mandatory annual general meetings (AGM) within six months of the financial year end.
checklist.1: Proper maintenance of share registers, dividend distribution accounts, and member attendance logs.
checklist.2: Adherence to statutory reserve fund allocations (typically 25% of net profit before patronage refund).
